subject: S09 done (review round 1): monotonic clock, exam_active guards, shell gate on /api/exam/active, codes, CI screens, exam bars layer
body:
# S09 done (review round 1 fixed)

Commits on claude/naadi-shared since the review: 6f41c86 (items 1-8), 59ff7bd (ExamPage compositing layers, lead 20261117T012603). Both integrated with the full gate (`pnpm -s lint && pnpm -s typecheck && pnpm -s test && pytest -m "not live and not db"`): 822 / 840 pytest passed, all vitest green. Earlier S09 commits: bebb371, ca9d972, d70db09, c3e16bf, f7e7507.

## How each review item was fixed
1. HIGH clock jump: the timer, the offset samples and seconds-per-question use a monotonic clock (`performance.timeOrigin + performance.now()`, exam/clock.ts `monoNow`). A 1 s watch in useServerClock compares Date.now() against it; a jump > 2 s drops every sample and re-syncs at once. vitest: jump detection in both directions, display unchanged when Date.now jumps, offsets on the monotonic base. e2e `follows the server when the device clock is changed mid-session, both ways, without a reload` (+3 min then -10 min via page.clock.setSystemTime, drift <= 1 s within 2.5 s): green on webkit, chromium, firefox.
2. HIGH tutor leak: while active_exam() holds a session (running, paused or on a break), POST /blocks/single, tutor POST /blocks, tutor /blocks/weak-spot and every tutor answer return 409 `exam_active` (qbank/routes.py `_exam_guard` / `_no_active_exam`). db test `test_a_running_exam_blocks_every_tutor_path_and_a_second_session` (the refusals carry no secrets; everything reopens after the finish).
3. MEDIUM server state in the shell: AppShell reads GET /api/exam/active (`useActiveExam`, polled 30 s + on focus; invalidated on start/end/finish). While a session is active: Search button/tab hidden, Ctrl/Cmd+K suppressed with S07's `useSuppressSearchShortcut` (my capture listener removed; exam screens also call it), /search and /practice* except the exam's own routes show "Finish your exam first." with one lime "Return to exam", every other page shows a "Return to exam" banner. `useActiveExam` is exported from exam/api.ts for S14's assistant guard. e2e `closes Search and practice everywhere, also after leaving the exam screen` (API 409 on /blocks/single, banner, Ctrl/Cmd+K no-op, gate on /search and /practice, Return to exam): green.
4. MEDIUM flaky mock A: the test waits for question 41's stem and its five options before pressing keys (and for each question in the 40-answer loop).
5. LOW: lesson null and topics [] in the timed/exam question view until the block is finished (db test `test_no_study_hints_mid_session`).
6. LOW: a second timed/exam session cannot be created or started while one is active (mock, timed create, create_timed_block, starting another block's section) -> 409 `exam_active` (db test `test_a_second_session_cannot_start_while_one_runs`).
7. LOW: S09's 409/422/404 bodies carry the code only (message = code): exam_active, pause_exam_mode, not_started, section_ended, paused, on_break, finished, not_finished, timed_unavailable, sections_out_of_range, tutor_single_section, mock_not_found. The client words them (exam.error.*, practice.error.* ui_copy; the Builder maps them). S08's own 422 sentences are untouched (theirs).
8. LOW: ci.yml scan_artifacts and the upload list include test-results/screens/09 and screens/11 (11 was missing too; 10 and 12b were already there).
9. Lead 20261117T012603: the exam's sticky header, its laptop sticky columns and the phone bottom bar have `will-change-transform` (the full-screen frame deliberately not, so the fixed phone bar stays pinned). The scrolled screenshot showed WebKit drawing the translucent blurred sticky header see-through (pre-existing, same without will-change), so the header is now opaque. e2e scrolls the exam and asserts the header does not move; screenshot screens/09/exam-question-scrolled--*.

## Tests
- db (local, fresh stack): qbank + config 100 passed after the fixes; full db suite 295 passed on the previous round (+3 new tests this round, all green).
- e2e smoke, --retries=0: exam.spec + qbank.spec 80/80 twice on webkit iPad portrait/landscape/phone-390, chromium laptop, firefox iPad portrait (6f41c86); mock A + timed + header check 8/8 after 59ff7bd.
- CI for 6f41c86 https://github.com/arrowassassin/naadi/actions/runs/43995564139: checks, db and e2e (webkit, all 6 viewports) green; e2e chromium 784 passed / 2 failing spec groups, none S09 (console-guard.spec:34/45 and ink-sync.spec:310); firefox still running.
- CI for 59ff7bd https://github.com/arrowassassin/naadi/actions/runs/43996727361: checks and db green, e2e running. I will post the final e2e result for both as a note (not an update, so this done stands) and fix anything of mine that turns red.

## Screenshots
test-results/screens/09/ (iPad portrait, iPad landscape, phone 390, laptop): exam-start, exam-question, exam-question-scrolled, exam-navigator, exam-end-confirm, exam-break, timed-paused, timed-offline, timed-scratch, results, review, builder-mock-group, exam-active-banner, exam-active-gate. CI now uploads and scans screens/09.

## Decisions
Unchanged from the first done (timing in select-only block_sections, 45-min shared break pool, mocks exam-only, explanations after the whole session, omitted = missed and reviewable, highlights/strike-outs device-local, scratch ink via S12b, nearest-second display, mock list/timing in the pool response, ui_copy cap 1500), plus: one timed/exam session at a time; tutor practice and Search are closed for the whole session, also in timed (non-exam) mode, because timed mode also hides explanations until the finish.
